This season I managed to get fertilizer and hybrid seed through the FISP program, so I will apply a small amount to this 0.05 hectare maize plot — just what the crop needs without wasting anything on such a small piece of land. I will not bother with pesticides or irrigation since we rely on the rains and chemicals are too expensive for maize. My family will do all the work because the plot is small, and I see no reason to hire outside labor when we can manage it ourselves.
